vb_textbox.text: I started by clicking on the gnome with the shorter hat and continued to select this gnome while the number of mushrooms collected ranged from 3 to 9. Once the number of mushrooms being collected drops to 2 or less I switched to the gnome with the larger hat and continued to select this gnome until again the number of mushrooms being collected dropped to 2 or less. At this point I switch to the gnome with the shorter hat and continue this pattern throughout the task.
